description: JSON Schema for session events emitted by the Copilot CLI runtime.
x-mark1-subset: verbatim definitions extracted from schemas/session-events.schema.json of @github/copilot-linux-x64@1.0.85 (sha256 20e13b3f689f554814142d3467fa1dd68469ddf16533954bd29ff89cbd8e805d); the full file is 856 KB

id.description: Unique event identifier (UUID v4), generated when the event is emitted

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the event was created

parentId.description: ID of the chronologically preceding event in the session, forming a linked chain. Null for the first event.

ephemeral.description: When true, the event is transient and not persisted to the session event log on disk

agentId.description: Sub-agent instance identifier. Absent for events from the root/main agent and session-level events.

data.description: Session initialization metadata including context and configuration

StartEvent.description: Session event "session.start". Session initialization metadata including context and configuration
StartEvent.title: StartEvent

version.description: Schema version number for the session event format

producer.description: Identifier of the software producing the events (e.g., "copilot-agent")

copilotVersion.description: Version string of the Copilot application

startTime.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the session was created

selectedModel.description: Model selected at session creation time, if any

reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort level used for model calls, if applicable (e.g. "none", "low", "medium", "high", "xhigh", "max")

reasoningSummary.description: Reasoning summary mode used for model calls, if applicable (e.g. "none", "concise", "detailed")

verbosity.description: Output verbosity level used for model calls, if applicable (e.g. "low", "medium", "high")

contextTier.description: Context tier selected at session creation time for models with tiered context pricing; null when no tier is selected (e.g., non-tiered model)

autoTier.description: Auto routing preference selected at session creation time

sessionLimits.description: Session limits configured at session creation time, if any

context.description: Working directory and git context at session start

githubMcpToolConfig.description: Per-session GitHub MCP override persisted for cold resume

alreadyInUse.description: Whether the session was already in use by another client at start time

remoteSteerable.description: Whether this session supports remote steering via GitHub

detachedFromSpawningParentSessionId.description: When set, identifies a parent session whose context this session continues — e.g., a detached headless rem-agent run launched on the parent's interactive shutdown. Telemetry from this session is reported under the parent's session_id.

StartData.description: Session initialization metadata including context and configuration
StartData.title: StartData

gitRoot.description: Root directory of the git repository, resolved via git rev-parse

repository.description: Repository identifier derived from the git remote URL ("owner/name" for GitHub, "org/project/repo" for Azure DevOps)

hostType.description: Hosting platform type of the repository (github or ado)

repositoryHost.description: Raw host string from the git remote URL (e.g. "github.com", "mycompany.ghe.com", "dev.azure.com")

headCommit.description: Head commit of current git branch at session start time

baseCommit.description: Base commit of current git branch at session start time

pendingGitContext.description: Set on the immediate preliminary event of a working-directory change, before the git context is resolved. A settled follow-up event (enriched with git context, or cwd-only for a non-repository) is always emitted afterward, so observers may defer to it. Absent on standalone/final events (e.g. relay context changes).

WorkingDirectoryContext.description: Working directory and git context at session start
WorkingDirectoryContext.title: WorkingDirectoryContext

agentId.description: Sub-agent instance identifier. Absent for events from the root/main agent and session-level events.

ShutdownEvent.description: Session event "session.shutdown". Session termination metrics including usage statistics, code changes, and shutdown reason
ShutdownEvent.title: ShutdownEvent

shutdownType.description: Whether the session ended normally ("routine") or due to a crash/fatal error ("error")

totalPremiumRequests.description: Total number of premium API requests used during the session

additionalProperties.description: A session-wide shutdown token-type entry storing the accumulated token count.

totalApiDurationMs.description: Cumulative time spent in API calls during the session, in milliseconds

sessionStartTime.description: Unix timestamp (milliseconds) when the session started

eventsFileSizeBytes.description: On-disk byte size of the session's persisted events.jsonl file at shutdown time; omitted when the file does not exist or cannot be stat'd

codeChanges.description: Aggregate code change metrics for the session

additionalProperties.description: Per-model shutdown metrics with request counts, token usage, nano-AI units, and token details.

modelMetrics.description: Per-model usage breakdown, keyed by model identifier

additionalProperties.description: Usage attributed to one agent instance at session shutdown.

agentMetrics.description: Per-agent usage breakdown, keyed by agent instance identifier. The main conversation uses the stable key `main`.

currentModel.description: Model that was selected at the time of shutdown

currentTokens.description: Total tokens in context window at shutdown

systemTokens.description: System message token count at shutdown

conversationTokens.description: Non-system message token count at shutdown

toolDefinitionsTokens.description: Tool definitions token count at shutdown

ShutdownData.description: Session termination metrics including usage statistics, code changes, and shutdown reason
ShutdownData.title: ShutdownData

ShutdownType.description: Whether the session ended normally ("routine") or due to a crash/fatal error ("error")
ShutdownType.title: ShutdownType

x-enumDescriptions.error: The session ended because of a crash or fatal error.

totalNanoAiu.description: Accumulated nano-AI units cost for this model

additionalProperties.description: A token-type entry in a shutdown model metric, storing the accumulated token count.

ShutdownModelMetric.description: Per-model shutdown metrics with request counts, token usage, nano-AI units, and token details.
ShutdownModelMetric.title: ShutdownModelMetric

count.description: Total number of API requests made to this model

cost.description: Cumulative cost multiplier for requests to this model

inputTokens.description: Total input tokens consumed across all requests to this model

outputTokens.description: Total output tokens produced across all requests to this model

cacheReadTokens.description: Total tokens read from prompt cache across all requests

cacheWriteTokens.description: Total tokens written to prompt cache across all requests

reasoningTokens.description: Total reasoning tokens produced across all requests to this model

id.description: Unique event identifier (UUID v4), generated when the event is emitted

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the event was created

parentId.description: ID of the chronologically preceding event in the session, forming a linked chain. Null for the first event.

ephemeral.description: Always true for events that are transient and not persisted to the session event log on disk.

agentId.description: Sub-agent instance identifier. Absent for events from the root/main agent and session-level events.

data.description: LLM API call usage metrics including tokens, costs, quotas, and billing information

AssistantUsageEvent.description: Session event "assistant.usage". LLM API call usage metrics including tokens, costs, quotas, and billing information
AssistantUsageEvent.title: AssistantUsageEvent

model.description: Model identifier used for this API call

cacheReadTokens.description: Number of tokens read from prompt cache

cacheWriteTokens.description: Number of tokens written to prompt cache

cacheExpiresAt.description: Updated prompt-cache expiration for this model call. Present only when the call establishes or refreshes known cache state.

reasoningTokens.description: Number of output tokens used for reasoning (e.g., chain-of-thought)

cost.description: Model multiplier cost for billing purposes

duration.description: Duration of the API call in milliseconds

timeToFirstTokenMs.description: Time to first token in milliseconds. Only available for streaming requests

outputTtftMs.description: Time to first observable model output in milliseconds. Includes text, reasoning, and tool-call output; only available for streaming requests that produce observable output.

interTokenLatencyMs.description: Average inter-token latency in milliseconds. Only available for streaming requests

initiator.description: What initiated this API call (e.g., "sub-agent", "mcp-sampling"); absent for user-initiated calls

interactionType.description: Coarse classification of the interaction that produced this call, mirroring the session's per-request agent context (e.g. `conversation-agent`, `conversation-subagent`, `conversation-sampling`, `conversation-background`, `conversation-compaction`, `conversation-user`). Non-billing; lets consumers attribute a model call to a call class (e.g. sub-agent/sidekick) independently of the billing initiator. Absent when the runtime did not classify the request.

isByok.description: Whether this model call used a bring-your-own-key provider

isAuto.description: Whether Auto mode was selected for this model call

maxPromptTokens.description: Effective maximum prompt-token limit used for this model call

maxOutputTokens.description: Requested maximum output tokens used for this model call

acceptedPredictionTokens.description: Number of accepted speculative prediction tokens

rejectedPredictionTokens.description: Number of rejected speculative prediction tokens

transport.description: Transport used for this model call (http or websocket)

apiCallId.description: Completion ID from the model provider (e.g., chatcmpl-abc123)

providerCallId.description: GitHub request tracing ID (x-github-request-id header) for server-side log correlation

serviceRequestId.description: Copilot service request ID (x-copilot-service-request-id header) for CAPI log correlation

rte.description: Per-request treatment/eligibility signal returned by the Copilot API in the `X-GitHub-Copilot-Request-TE` response header for the associated model call; `false` when the header was absent or unparseable.

apiEndpoint.description: API endpoint used for this model call, matching CAPI supported_endpoints vocabulary

parentToolCallId.description: Parent tool call ID when this usage originates from a sub-agent

additionalProperties.description: Internal per-quota snapshot for assistant usage, including entitlement, consumed requests, overage, reset date, and remaining quota.

quotaSnapshots.description: Per-quota resource usage snapshots, keyed by quota identifier

copilotUsage.description: Per-request cost and usage data from the CAPI copilot_usage response field

reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort level used for model calls, if applicable (e.g. "none", "low", "medium", "high", "xhigh", "max")

reasoningSummary.description: Reasoning summary mode used for this model call, if applicable

availableToolCount.description: Number of tools available to the model for this call

toolTokenCount.description: Number of tokens used by tool definitions for this call

frontierSource.description: How the prompt-cache frontier was determined for this call

cacheTtlSeconds.description: Effective prompt-cache lifetime in seconds for this call

cacheDetailsReported.description: Whether the provider reported prompt-cache usage details for this call

numToolCalls.description: Number of tool calls returned by the model

toolCounts.description: Tool-call counts keyed by tool name

finishReason.description: Finish reason reported by the model for this API call (e.g. "stop", "length", "tool_calls", "content_filter"). Normalized to OpenAI vocabulary; for Anthropic models a "refusal" stop reason maps to "content_filter".

contentFilterTriggered.description: Whether the model response was blocked or truncated by content filtering (finish_reason === 'content_filter'). For Anthropic models this corresponds to a 'refusal' stop reason.

fusion.description: Experimental HydraFusion attribution for this concrete model call's usage.

AssistantUsageData.description: LLM API call usage metrics including tokens, costs, quotas, and billing information
AssistantUsageData.title: AssistantUsageData

data.description: Hook invocation start details including type and input data

HookStartEvent.description: Session event "hook.start". Hook invocation start details including type and input data
HookStartEvent.title: HookStartEvent

hookInvocationId.description: Unique identifier for this hook invocation

input.description: Input data passed to the hook. For postToolUse hooks the retained copy served by session.eventLog.read (and by a resumed session) drops the tool result's inline `contents`/`uiResource`/`skillInvocation` and replaces duplicated text result fields with a `[copilot:elided ...]` marker; the live subscription stream still delivers the full value. Canonical tool output remains in the adjacent tool.execution_complete event, while an invoked skill's authoritative body remains in its skill invocation event.

parentToolCallId.description: Tool call ID of the parent tool invocation when this event originates from a sub-agent

HookStartData.description: Hook invocation start details including type and input data
HookStartData.title: HookStartData

HookEndEvent.description: Session event "hook.end". Hook invocation completion details including output, success status, and error information
HookEndEvent.title: HookEndEvent

hookInvocationId.description: Identifier matching the corresponding hook.start event

hookType.description: Type of hook that was invoked (e.g., "preToolUse", "postToolUse", "sessionStart")

output.description: Output data produced by the hook. Durable and resumed postToolUse receipts may omit messages owned by a successful skill invocation and replace an unchanged skill sessionLog copy with an elision marker; hook-modified or re-sourced values are preserved, and the authoritative body remains in the skill invocation event.

error.description: Error details when the hook failed

parentToolCallId.description: Tool call ID of the parent tool invocation when this event originates from a sub-agent

HookEndData.description: Hook invocation completion details including output, success status, and error information
HookEndData.title: HookEndData
